question: The writer is considering deleting the sentence "A curtain has been drawn back." from the end of paragraph 2. Should the writer make this deletion?

options.A: Yes, because paragraph 2 has not yet said that the yellow was present all along, so the image has nothing to refer to.
options.B: No, because it closes the paragraph with a picture of the "revealing" that paragraph 1 promised, a picture paragraph 5 restates as subtraction.
options.C: No, because it explains how the tree stops producing chlorophyll once the days begin to shorten.
options.D: Yes, because the image of a curtain conflicts with the sunscreen comparison that paragraph 4 applies to the same pigments.
